hero.text: Feline Fairies is a volunteer-run, foster-based cat rescue in St. Augustine. People help keep the rescue moving in different ways, with their time, care, and practical skills.

paragraphs: There is no shelter building. The work happens through foster homes and the people who support them.
You do not need to foster a cat to contribute. Many small, practical contributions can help the rescue care for cats and connect them with homes.

image.alt: A volunteer helping organize supplies for a cat rescue

ways.text: Volunteer needs can change. These are examples of support to explore with the rescue, rather than a list of open positions.

items.title: Events & outreach
items.text: Help with community outreach or adoption events when opportunities are available.

items.title: Time with cats
items.text: Spend time helping cats feel comfortable when the rescue has an appropriate need.

items.title: Transport
items.text: Help with practical transportation when arrangements and needs align.

items.title: Behind the scenes
items.text: Offer organization, communication, supply support, creative skills, or other practical help.

fit.text: Different people have different schedules, comfort levels, and skills. Tell the rescue what interests you and what feels manageable.
ideas: Have a skill you would like to offer?

process.title: Start with a conversation.

items.title: Apply
items.text: Tell us a little about yourself, your interests, and your availability.

items.title: Connect
items.text: A volunteer can follow up and learn more about how you would like to help.

items.title: Find a fit
items.text: If there is a current need that matches, the rescue can discuss possible next steps.

items.title: Lend a hand
items.text: Help where your time and skills can support the rescue.

process.fosterPrompt: Interested in welcoming a cat into your home?

closing.text: If you would like to volunteer, start with the application and tell us a little about your interests, availability, and skills.
